placeName.zh-CN: 意大利库尔马约尔至法国霞慕尼

details.distanceMethod: Official 2026 race stat block: 145 km. The official UTMB Index race page gives 154 km, the official embedded course trace measures 150.772 km, and third-party tables range from about 147 to 151 km. This card uses the race stat block; the page presents all published values side by side and uses the official 150.772 km trace for checkpoint distances.
details.elevationMethod: Official 2026 race stat block: 9,500 m positive gain. The official embedded trace computes +9,322 / −9,509 m. This card uses the stat block; the page uses the trace values for the point-by-point table.
